mapper.insert: insert into learning_study_record (user_id, study_date, seconds, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{studyDate}, #{seconds}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update seconds = seconds + #{seconds}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(seconds), 0) from learning_study_record where user_id = #{userId} and study_date = #{studyDate}
select study_date from learning_study_record where user_id = #{userId} and study_date >= #{fromDate} and seconds > 0 order by study_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into learning_course_progress (user_id, course_id, video_id, finished, watched_seconds, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{videoId}, #{finished}, #{seconds}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update finished = greatest(finished, #{finished}), watched_seconds = watched_seconds + #{seconds}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select course_id from learning_course_video where video_id = #{videoId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update learning_course_video set duration = #{duration} where video_id = #{videoId} and duration is null and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_short_video where video_id = #{videoId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'

select count(*) from ( select c.course_id from learning_course c join learning_course_video v on v.course_id = c.course_id and v.del_flag = '0' left join learning_course_progress p on p.user_id = #{userId} and p.video_id = v.video_id and p.finished = 1 where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.course_id having count(*) = count(p.video_id) ) t
select count(*) from learning_course_progress where user_id = #{userId} and finished = 0 and watched_seconds > 0
select count(*) from learning_note where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
